_doc: Council zoning map services, each tested with a point query on 9 Oct 2026 (no login needed). Fields name the attributes holding zone / precinct / local plan / local-plan precinct text. precinct_layer: precincts live on a separate layer. null_values: strings that mean 'none'. local_plan_layer / local_plan_precinct_layer: neighbourhood plans on separate layers (precinct matched by code, e.g. NPP-001). overlay_layers: overlay polygons; 'map' turns the field text into regs.overlays ids. scheme_viewer: the council's official planning-scheme website (for people; not queried).

BRISBANE.notes: Brisbane City Plan 2014 open data (edited 2026-09-17). LVL2_ZONE carries the precinct in brackets, e.g. 'Character residential (Character)'. The zoning layer's NP / NP_PREC fields are empty or repeat the zone precinct (checked 12 Oct 2026), so neighbourhood plans come from the separate NP boundary / precinct layers. Overlays: Traditional building character (sub-category in OVL2_DESC) and Dwelling house character. Not looked up: Pre-1911 building, flood, heritage and other overlays.

GOLD_COAST.notes: City Plan Version 13 open data; the scheme in force is Version 14 (no V14 zone layer published) — check for zoning changes. Overlays (tested 15 Oct 2026): City Plan V13 open data FeatureServer (CC BY 4.0, last edit 2026-06-01), except road widening from the council's V14 MapServer (maps1). Building height: HEIGHT_IN_METRES ('9m', '15m'…; 'HX' and PDA/Spit text give no number).

MORETON_BAY.notes: Parcel-based zone polygons; last edited Oct 2024 — may lag recent amendments. Overlays (tested 15 Oct 2026): council open data on ArcGIS Online, CC BY 4.0 (building heights Oct 2021; others 2016 versions, edited 2022). Building height parsed from OVL2_DESC ('Max 8.5m'); OVL2_CAT has a data error. North Lakes Locality is outside the scheme overlays (zoning returns 'Not applicable'). Local plan precincts come from LP / LP_PREC; Caboolture West sub-precincts (e.g. Next generation) are not in any public queryable layer. Changes since Oct 2024 are by TLPI (PlanningScheme_Temporary_Local_Planning_Instruments) — not looked up.

SUNSHINE_COAST.notes: Layer carries no version/date. Overlays and local plans (tested 15 Oct 2026): council MapServers Overlays_SCC / Boundaries_SCC on geoimage.scc.qld.gov.au (current amended scheme; CC BY 3.0 AU). Height from LABEL ('8.5 metres'; 'Unspecified maximum height' gives no number). Do not use the 2024 OpenData copy (lags amendments) or the 'scrcpublic' layers (proposed 2025 scheme, not in force).

overlay_layers.name: Height of buildings and structures overlay

LOGAN.notes: Logan Planning Scheme 2015 v9.2 incorporating TLPI No.1 2024 (registered by Logan City Council on ArcGIS Online, CC BY 3.0 AU). Hosted on a consultant's (WSP) server; service names carry the version and date, so re-check the URL at each amendment (a draft new scheme exists, Aug 2025). The non-TLPI v9_2 service has no TLPI flood layers. Residential overlay (OM-10.00) decides whether the Dwelling house code applies. Tested 15 Oct 2026. Zones and precincts: Logan's own 'Zones_V9_2_WFL1' (edited 17 Jul 2025, after v9.2 commenced; identical to the contractor-hosted v9.2 service: 6,920 zones and 6,710 precincts, the same answer at every one of 197 test points; checked 2026-10-21). Local plans, local-plan precincts and overlays: the contractor-hosted LoganHub service (registered by Logan City Council).

Flood hazard overlay - flood risk areas (TLPI 1/2024)
Landslide hazard and steep slope overlay (OM-08.00 trigger)

IPSWICH.notes: Ipswich City Plan 2025 zones layer requires a login token (499 Token Required). Choose the zone manually; ask Ipswich City Council for open-data access.

REDLAND.notes: Redland City Plan Version 14. Precincts are codes (LDR1-LDR5). Overlays from the same open-data service (CC BY-SA 4.0 — share-alike; data 2025-11-10). Precinct values are codes; '<Null>' means none. Canal/lake revetment walls (LDR5 9 m) are only in council asset data (gis.redland.qld.gov.au assets/a_parks_transport/MapServer/18) — not looked up yet.

overlay_layers.name: Flood and storm tide hazard overlay

TOOWOOMBA.notes: Toowoomba Regional Planning Scheme. Layer 170 ('Zones', under group layer 165) also carries QPP_Zone/Precinct numeric codes with no exposed domain — the TRPS_Zones/TRPS_Precinct string fields are used instead, confirmed by a live point query (verified 26 Oct 2026: CBD point returned TRPS_Zones='Principal Centre', TRPS_Precinct='No Precinct'). A dedicated precinct layer also exists at .../MapServer/167 (fields Precinct, Precinct_Label, Precinct_Description) if a standalone precinct lookup is ever needed. Only the zones this project has researched (Low Density Residential, Low-medium Density Residential, Community Facilities, Emerging Community, Rural, Rural Residential, Specialised Centre, Township) have rules; other live zone text (e.g. 'Principal Centre') correctly has none yet. Local plan layers (Charlton Wellcamp, Glenvale, Highfields/Meringandan) not yet located on this service — local plan detection remains to be wired up.

TOWNSVILLE.notes: Townsville City Plan 2014. LVL2_ZONE is the specific zone name (LVL1_ZONE is the broader group, e.g. 'Centre' vs 'Principal Centre'); TCC_CODE carries the short code but is not used here since LVL2_ZONE already matches our zone names. Verified by a live point query (26 Oct 2026: Townsville CBD returned LVL1_ZONE='Centre', LVL2_ZONE='Principal Centre', TCC_CODE='PC'). No *scheme* overlay (flood/heritage/character precinct) layers are published by the council as public ArcGIS feature services -- only the zone/precinct/local-plan fields on this one layer are queryable for zoning. Correction, 29 Oct 2026: the council DOES publish a bushfire-prone-area layer plus its own sewer/water asset layers on this same org -- wired in poc/site_layers.json under TOWNSVILLE (categories Bushfire/Sewer/Water).

LIVINGSTONE.notes: Livingstone Shire Planning Scheme 2018 v4. Verified by live query (26 Oct 2026): Adopted Zones layer (/10) field 'Zone' gives plain names e.g. 'Rural', 'Community facilities'; Zone Precinct Boundaries layer (/0) field 'Precinct' gives e.g. 'Capricorn Coast Rural Precinct' (matches our registered precinct names directly). Seaspray local plan is on separate layers (/3 boundary, /5 precincts, fields Name/LPP/LPPName). Overlays (bushfire, flood, coastal, acid sulphate soils etc., ~20 'OMxx' layers) exist in the same org but are published as cached TilesOnly MapServers -- not queryable via REST, so none are wired here. Exception found 29 Oct 2026: 'Storm_Tide_Tsunami' (not an 'OMxx' name) is a real queryable FeatureServer on this same org -- its 9 layers (HAT, 6 storm-surge bands, tsunami) are wired in poc/site_layers.json under LIVINGSTONE, category Coastal.

ROCKHAMPTON.notes: Rockhampton Regional Planning Scheme. Verified by live query (26 Oct 2026): Land_Use_Zones field 'Zone_Lable' gives the plain zone name (e.g. 'Rural'), separate from 'Zone' which carries a 'L1 - ' map-sheet prefix. Precinct layer field 'DESCRIPTION' used as the precinct name. Heritage, flood, bushfire (per-class), steep land, coastal and acid sulfate soils layers exist on this same org and are now wired in poc/site_layers.json under ROCKHAMPTON (19 layers total, verified live 29 Oct 2026) -- as site constraints, not as zoning_layers overlay_layers, since our dataset has no RRC heritage/flood overlay_id registered to map them to (only RRC:OV:CHARACTER_OVERLAY_* / COASTAL_PROTECTION_OVERLAY / FLOOD_HAZARD_OVERLAY_* exist, not yet matched to a specific layer -- that rule-scoping link, if needed, is separate follow-up work). No Local Plan layer found.

BURKE.notes: Burke Shire Planning Scheme, Nov 2024. Verified by live query (26 Oct 2026): field 'ZONE' gives plain names (e.g. 'Rural', 'Township'); 'PRECINCT' gives the Township zone's precinct (e.g. 'Residential'), null outside Township. Hosted by Qld DSDIP on behalf of the council (ArcGIS item titled 'DRAFT ... PROD' is an internal versioning label, not an unpublished draft -- it is the service linked from the council's own public 'Interactive Mapping' page). Flood overlay layers (Queensland floodplain assessment overlay, Gregory/Burketown 1% AEP) exist on the same service but are not wired as overlays here (no BSC overlay_id registered yet).

MOUNT_ISA.notes: Mount Isa City Planning Scheme. Verified by live query (26 Oct 2026): field 'Zone_Legend' gives the full zone name (e.g. 'Rural', 'Environmental Management and Conservation', 'Special Purpose'); 'LVL2_Zone' is a coarser/sparser field, not used. No precinct field on this layer -- precinct-style areas (CBD, Airport, Stables, Leichhardt River) are published as separate named precinct/overlay layers instead, not wired here. The combined 'Planning_Scheme_Overlays_(public)' layer (field OverlayDescription) is wired below (29 Oct 2026) -- no MICC overlay_id is registered in regs.overlays for any of its 7 values (Airport local plan, Extractive resources, Flood hazard, Heritage, Lake Moondarra environs, Major infrastructure, Scenic amenity), since no curated Mount Isa rule is scoped to an overlay yet, so every hit surfaces as an informational 'not mapped to an overlay in the rules dataset' note rather than driving a rule -- still real signal (which overlay a lot sits in), not a blocked lookup.

CENTRAL_HIGHLANDS.notes: No public GIS service exists for Central Highlands' planning-scheme zoning, confirmed by two passes (26 Oct 2026). First pass: no ArcGIS REST FeatureServer/MapServer (incl. the Qld DSDIP remote-council hosting program that covers Burke -- Central Highlands is not on it); the council's own ArcGIS org only carries shared disaster-management layers (flood extents), not zoning. Correction, 29 Oct 2026: that same org (xYbmdyJFb3eEmMJp) carries a fuller set of genuinely queryable overlays than flood extents alone -- flood (3 layers), bushfire, and heritage (4 layers) are wired in poc/site_layers.json under CENTRAL_HIGHLANDS. These work independent of zoning (site constraints only need lot geometry), so they're usable even with a manually-chosen zone. Second, deeper pass checked (without touching the bot-protected ePlan portal itself): candidate GIS subdomains (maps/gis/data.chrc.qld.gov.au) all NXDOMAIN; the council website's only mapping links route to ePlan; the State's own ArcGIS platform (spatial-gis.information.qld.gov.au, PlanningCadastre folder) has no zoning/planning-scheme layer for any council, confirming QLD zoning is always council-hosted, never state-aggregated; data.qld.gov.au / data.gov.au / Queensland Globe have no matching dataset. Choose the zone manually; the council's own lookup tool is its ePlan portal.

SOUTH_BURNETT.notes: South Burnett's interactive zoning map runs on IntraMaps (TechnologyOne), not Esri ArcGIS, confirmed by two passes (26 Oct 2026). First pass: no ArcGIS endpoint or open-data portal with equivalent boundaries found. Second, deeper pass checked (without probing the IntraMaps viewer's own internal API): every alternative top-level path on the IntraMaps host (rest/services, wms, wfs, arcgis/rest) redirects back to the same viewer page -- no separate OGC/REST service sits alongside it; candidate GIS subdomains (maps/gis.southburnett.qld.gov.au) NXDOMAIN; the council's own 'Online Maps' page only links to the State's Queensland Globe/SARA tools and this same IntraMaps viewer; data.qld.gov.au / data.gov.au / the State's ArcGIS platform have no matching zoning dataset. Choose the zone manually using the council's own IntraMaps viewer.
